headline: Ross Stores Delivers Strong Q3 Results and Updates Fiscal 2026 Outlook
summary: Ross Stores reported strong third-quarter sales and earnings for the 13-week period ended October 31, 2026. The off-price apparel retailer also updated its fourth-quarter and fiscal 2026 financial guidance.
why: Ross Stores is one of the largest discount department store operators in the United States. Its financial performance offers significant insight into consumer discretionary spending and price sensitivity.
